🔥 Top Stories
• US payrolls shock lower at -23K — July jobs missed by a wide margin, revisions cut 103K, wages cooled; September Fed hike odds dropped and stocks/risk assets rallied
• Dollar and yields fall, yen/gold jump — weaker labor data sent the dollar to a 3-month low, the yen up about 1%, and gold near $4,366/oz on softer Fed expectations
• US tariff talks with Canada intensify — Ottawa and Washington are in daily talks to avert Aug. 19 tariffs, with Canada weighing concessions for partial relief
• US Senate passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill — 86-11 bipartisan vote sends tougher energy sanctions legislation to the House
• US Treasury targets Iran-linked crypto networks — sanctions hit exchanges and entities tied to the IRGC as Washington steps up pressure on illicit finance

⛽ Oil & Energy
• Oil rises on geopolitics — Brent settled at $83.55 and WTI at $78.18 as Middle East/Ukraine supply risks stayed elevated
• ADNOC vessels attacked; Hormuz talks progress — UAE said 15 vessels were attacked, while US officials said a deal with Iran/Oman on shipping through Hormuz may be near
• Russia hits Ukrainian gas sites — overnight strikes on 7 gas production sites keep European energy risk in focus

📊 Markets & Macro
• Stocks rally on dovish Fed repricing — US equities extended gains after the jobs miss; Nasdaq led as rate-hike fears faded
• Bond traders brace for data; then reprice fast — market went from pricing a September hike to sharply lowering odds after the payrolls shock
• BofA warns sentiment is stretched — bullish positioning hit extremes last seen in 2021, suggesting a risk-off setup
• NY Fed inflation expectations steady — 1-year eased to 3.63%, with 3-year at 3.3% and 5-year at 3.0%
• Canada jobs beat sharply — +75.1K jobs and 6.4% unemployment added to the North American macro divergence

🌍 Geopolitical
• Middle East security tensions persist — Iran, Yemen, Saudi-linked forces and Gulf security all stayed active, with intermittent attack claims and diplomacy
• US warns on Russia/NATO risk — intel reports said Russia may test NATO countries within years, keeping defense spending in focus
• China eyes regular Northern Sea Route shipping — potential Arctic logistics shift for Europe trade flows

🪙 Crypto & DeFi
• Trump bullish on Bitcoin — he said crypto is a “big deal” and that Bitcoin takes pressure off the dollar
• Bitcoin holds near $65K — crypto traded firmer alongside the weaker dollar and softer-rate outlook
• Trump Media unwinds crypto deals — planned Crypto.com deals were terminated, a setback for the stock’s crypto angle
• Bybit sues Lazarus over $1.5B hack — exchange seeks asset freeze in a major cyber/crypto case

🏛️ Regulatory & Policy
• Trump moves on Fed governor Cook — reports say he’s considering removing Lisa Cook, renewing Fed-independence concerns
• BLS and CEA leadership confirmed — Senate confirmed new BLS commissioner Brett Matsumoto and CEA chair Christopher Phelan
• US Army opens test ranges to private firms — part of a push to break the munitions bottleneck
• Pentagon advances Golden Dome plan — funding, timelines and first tests for the secret space-based missile defense program are being set

🏢 Corporate
